summary: Manager, Quantitative Analytics & Reporting candidate with ~7 years in investment and market risk analytics across Moody's Analytics, EY, and Ortec Finance. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement. Hands-on with VaR and CVaR optimization, risk decomposition and attribution, stress testing and scenario analysis, derivatives validation, and Python analytics pipelines. CFA charterholder; dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Chemical Engineering).

sections.heading: Risk Analytics Validation & Insight
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming that sensitivities and scenario impacts remain consistent at portfolio-level aggregates.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream risk and capital processes.
Escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; serve as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

sections.heading: Portfolio Exposure, Stress & Scenario Analytics
bullets: Oversee interest-rate exposure and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks across multi-asset institutional portfolios.
Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across multi-year horizons.

sections.heading: Risk Reporting, Automation & Governance
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.
Prepare analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering portfolio exposures, scenario impacts, and interest-rate sensitivities, translating quantitative output into committee-ready narratives.
Serve on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms on the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms, acting as technical liaison between client investment teams and product/development functions.
Migrated all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to PFaroe PM, validating model outputs post-deployment.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning reporting requirements with system implementation.
Coordinated actuarial, finance, IT, and risk stakeholders on milestone delivery, governance documentation, and regulatory-readiness materials.
Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, testing allocation robustness through near-optimal frontier analysis.
Produced risk decomposition and risk attribution analytics (contribution-to-risk, risk budgeting) for multi-asset institutional mandates.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators quantifying interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet exposures.
Conducted cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk, including liability-driven investment (LDI) trade-off analysis.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations on-site to investment committees at pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
